address: 5887 Enriquez Street, Poblacion, Makati - Metro Manila, The Philippines
bio: This retro-style restaurant pays tribute to classic Cantonese clay pot rice, featuring a crispy rice crust. A fragrant sauce with a soy-sweet aroma is poured at the table. Each dish is cooked to order and well worth the 20-30min wait – order dim sum as a tasty appetiser.
